most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Legionnaires' disease (Legionella infection) with SIADH-type hyponatremia; tick-borne ehrlichiosis is the main alternative outside the list
one_line_reason: Fever, profuse diarrhea, confusion, worsening hyponatremia, AST-predominant transaminitis and a low-normal WBC in an older diabetic man with COPD fit the classic Legionella picture. Enteric Salmonella/typhoid (melena, relative leukopenia) and anticoagulant-related adrenal crisis are close competitors, and ehrlichiosis stays possible because tick bites were specifically asked about.
